findings.current: “A report that he passed through the north gate came in two shichen[^1] ago.”
findings.defect: The draft moves the two-shichen timestamp from Jeok Cheongang’s passage through the gate to the report’s arrival.
findings.rationale: 두 시진 전 modifies 북문을 통과했다, so it was the passage through the north gate—not the report’s arrival—that occurred two shichen earlier.
findings.replacement: “The report says he passed through the north gate two shichen[^1] ago.”

findings.current: From the time he had taken the position of Family Head until now, he had received countless reports from the Hidden Thread and asked for its opinions. Yet he had never once spoken with certainty.
findings.defect: The repeated masculine pronoun makes the middle-aged Family Head the person who had never spoken with certainty, whereas the source identifies the Hidden Thread as the normally noncommittal speaker.
findings.rationale: 단언한 적이 없던 그 refers to the Hidden Thread, as confirmed by the following contrast and his unusually categorical explanation.
findings.replacement: From the time he had become Family Head until now, the middle-aged man had received countless reports from the Hidden Thread and asked for his opinions, but the Hidden Thread had never once spoken with certainty.
findings.source: 가주 자리에 오른 뒤부터 지금까지, 비선으로부터 수많은 보고를 받고 의견을 물었지만 단 한 번도 단언한 적이 없던 그다.

findings.current: *It has to be one of two things. Either he has a weakness on the Fire King, or he possesses martial talent so extraordinary that his age and background are irrelevant.*
findings.defect: “Has a weakness on” is not natural English and obscures the intended idea that Jin Taekyung may have obtained leverage over the Fire King.
findings.rationale: 약점을 잡다 means to discover or seize upon someone’s weakness and thereby gain leverage over them.
findings.replacement: *It has to be one of two things. Either he has some leverage over the Fire King, or he possesses martial talent so extraordinary that his age and background are irrelevant.*
findings.source: ‘둘 중 하나겠지. 화왕의 약점을 잡았거나, 나이와 출신 따위는 상관없을 정도로 극히 뛰어난 무재를 갖고 있거나.’

findings.current: “It doesn’t matter. I’ll give you half a month. Use every means necessary and find out everything about that Disciple.”
findings.defect: The draft halves the allotted investigation period.
findings.rationale: 달포 means approximately one month; the later 보름 refers separately to the Hidden Thread’s anticipated fortnight of intense work.
findings.replacement: “It doesn’t matter. I’ll give you a month. Use every means necessary and find out everything about that Disciple.”
findings.source: “상관없네. 달포를 줄 테니 무슨 수를 써서라도 그 제자에 관한 모든 걸 알아 오게.”

findings.current: “Do you want to be rude in your pants? Should I make you shit and piss yourself for the rest of your life, not just this once?”
findings.defect: The literal phrase “be rude in your pants” is unintelligible in English and fails to convey the bodily-accident euphemism behind Jeok Cheongang’s retort.
findings.rationale: 바지에 실례하다 humorously turns 실례 from social discourtesy into the euphemistic act of soiling oneself; “have an accident” preserves that euphemistic shift naturally.
findings.replacement: “Want to have an accident in your pants? Should I make you shit and piss yourself for the rest of your life, not just this once?”
findings.source: “바지에 실례하고 싶으냐? 이번 한 번이 아니라 평생 똥오줌 질질 싸게 해 줘?”

findings.current: I had barely gotten to tear off a few pieces of meat when some dark-path knife-wielding bastards popped up and interfered. Then the Under Armour monk appeared and took me to Shaolin Temple.
findings.defect: The established category term 흑도 is not rendered as “dark-path figures,” and “popped up and interfered” is awkwardly literal.
findings.rationale: 흑도 denotes the established category “dark-path figures,” while 훼방을 놓다 means that they disrupted or ruined what Taekyung was trying to enjoy.
findings.replacement: I had barely gotten to tear off a few pieces of meat when some sword-wielding dark-path figures showed up and ruined everything. Then the Under Armour monk appeared and took me to Shaolin Temple.
findings.source: 이제 겨우 고기 몇 점 뜯어 먹나 했더니, 웬 흑도 칼잡이 놈들이 튀어나와 훼방을 놓고 언더아머 스님이 나타나서 소림사로 데려가더라.

findings.defect: The draft uses two separate strong profanities for the source’s single curse, unnecessarily intensifying the line.
findings.rationale: 시벌 is one strong muttered curse; the remainder is a sarcastic expression of gratitude without an additional profanity.

summary: The draft contains three fact-level errors involving timing, subject attribution, and duration, plus localized issues with terminology, idiomatic English, euphemistic humor, and profanity intensity.
